Beautiful 3bed unit in the new surburb of Canberra
Chic Vibes in a Lakeside Townhouse
listing_info.description:
This gorgeous home features a contemporary interior where minimalist-inspired spaces intertwine with wooden textures and soft greys. Lounge on the comfortable sofa while watching Netflix and spend the afternoon on the outdoor patio.

BEDROOM:
The first bedroom has queen-sized beds while the second and third one have a double bed.

All beds are topped with fresh linens that are professionally cleaned and pressed after each stay. Also, the bedroom has a lot of wardrobe space for your luggage.

BATHROOM:
The townhouse has 2 bath and toilets and 1 stand-alone toilet room. I will provide complimentary towels, shampoo, toilet paper and body wash.

KITCHEN:
You can use the kitchen whenever you're craving for home-cooked meals and has:
- fridge/freezer
- stovetop
- dishwasher
- plates, glasses, and utensils
- cooking pots and pans
- a basic selection of breakfast foods such as muesli, milk, coffee and tea. Guests will need to stock food items for longer stays.

LIVING ROOM:
The living room has a 55 inch smart TV with Free Netflix that you can use.

LAUNDRY AREA:
A washer is available to use, as well as an iron and ironing board.

There is a courtyard that you can use for a quick chilling out after a long, tiring day.

There is a key-safe for self check-in, although I am just a message away if you need help checking-in.

Guests are left to enjoy the privacy of their own space; however, you are welcome to contact me via Airbnb any time and I’ll endeavour to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

The townhouse is within walking distance of Lake Ginninderra which offers stunning views and scenic trails for hiking and riding a bike. There's an array of restaurants and cafes nearby with the bus stop next door making it easy to explore Canberra.

Located within walking distance to Lake Ginninderra and an array of restaurants and cafes. The bus stop (Number 250, 52 and 53) is conveniently next door ensuring you can get around Canberra easily.

listing_info.listing_name: Fully furnished studio apartment in Canberra
listing_info.description:
Cosy & spacious - studio located under our house, with its own street entrance, within Belconnen suburb of Scullin. It's walking distance to public transport, Hawker shops and restaurants. Also, very close to Belconnen shopping centre, University of Canberra, Canberra Civic and the Australian National University. There is a BBQ on the property, and your more than welcome to use the main house balcony to relax.

The space
You get exactly whats in the photographs, the designer bathroom is all yours. The light-filled spacious living area is ideal for holiday makers, especially visits to canberra for work or family. Studio is also includes off street carpark, heater, hairdryer, all linen, extra blankets and soap. The studio is completely private from the rest of the house. There is a queen bed, and a airbed and portal cot is available upon request. Its Eco friendly using solar hot water and has solar passive double glazed uPVC windows so you will be warm in winter and cool in summer. There is a sun air fan to keep cool. Its located 5 mins walk from Woolworths Hawker close to local take away and fine dining restaurants. It has a SmartTV with Foxtel Now and access to our Telstra NBN wifi. For your cooking needs there is a Webber Q BBQ on the property that you are more than welcome to use.

Guest access
There is an off street car park, which is right next to the entrance to the bnb. If I can't be home to greet you on arrival the key will be securely stowed ready for you.

Other things to note
Westfield Belconnen is only 5 mins away by Car.
